name: sim_toric_torch_foundation
description: Torch-native Toric geometry foundation: T² action on ℂ², moment map μ(z₁,z₂)=(|z₁|²,|z₂|²), polytope constraints, torus orbits — all torch float64 with autograd. numpy→torch migration proof-of-concept.

pytorch.reason: T² action on ℂ² as torch float64 reals; moment map μ(z₁,z₂)=(|z₁|²,|z₂|²); norm constraints; autograd through moment map

z3.reason: UNSAT: μ₁ < 0 ∧ μ₁ = |z₁|² contradictory (moment map is non-negative)

cvc5.reason: z3 constraint solving sufficient for moment map UNSAT

sympy.reason: Symbolic T² action e^{iθ}z and moment map μ(z)=|z|² constraint

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed for toric moment map foundation

geomstats.reason: Riemannian geometry backend not needed for this migration

e3nn.reason: Equivariant neural networks not required for foundation sim

rustworkx.reason: Graph algorithms not applicable to toric moment maps

xgi.reason: Hypergraph structure not needed for torus action

toponetx.reason: Topological complexes not required for moment polytope

gudhi.reason: Persistent homology not needed for toric foundation

P1_torus_action_rotation.description: T¹ action e^{iθ} rotates z=1 by θ

P3_torus_2pi_periodicity.description: 2π rotation is identity on T¹ orbit

P4_moment_map_unit_polytope.description: Moment map of unit-norm (z₁,z₂) satisfies μ₁ + μ₂ ≤ 1

P5_moment_map_nonnegative.description: Moment map μ = (|z₁|², |z₂|²) is always nonnegative

P6_autograd_moment_map.description: Moment map is differentiable w.r.t. z₁, z₂ via pytorch autograd

P7_sympy_moment_map_formula.description: sympy: moment map μ(z) = |z|² verified symbolically

P8_torus_orbit_representative.description: Orbit representative satisfies prescribed moment value

N2_polytope_violation_large_norms.description: Large-norm pairs violate unit polytope constraint

N3_negative_moment_impossible.description: Negative moment coordinate is impossible (norm is real and nonnegative)

B1_zero_moment.description: Zero vector has zero moment map

B2_torus_boundary_preserves_sphere.description: T¹ action preserves unit sphere boundary

B3_moment_map_continuity.description: Moment map varies continuously under small perturbations

migration_notes: This sim establishes the torch-native pattern for Toric family migration. Next: port toric lego sims to use these primitives.
